dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGW24 handles hospital admission basic information settings.
evidence: EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (claims) processing system - hospital/clinic admission basic information settings screen (W24)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles the screen logic for hospital admission basic information settings (入院基本情報設定), managing combo-box initialization, screen transitions, data entry validation, and SPA (scratchpad area) management for the W24 screen window.

notable_features: 42 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, W01-W27 screen areas)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen handling
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP (Medical Care Platform) interface
170 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
OCCURS tables for medical procedure codes (CONST-NYUKSN-SRYCD-OCC OCCURS 20)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (appears garbled in latin-1). This is a subprogram called via CALL/LINK mechanism using MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT event model characteristic of JMA ORCA. The program_type is listed as online-cics as the closest analog to the event-driven screen handling, though ORCA uses its own MCP framework rather than CICS.
